revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: 20261120 bounded native USER causal diagnostic only. No guest context, EIP, callback ownership, queue selection, validation or consumption decision changes. Native path adds records to per-instance globals; no guest memory or shared region storage. Worker opt-in captures native records before existing host imports and before/after existing CPU slice/local waits, preserving original receivers, results and exceptions; no callback driver is added. Per-configuration single use nonce, finite30s lifetime, explicit cancel, replacement, retirement, errors and overflow stop collection; no post-close endpoint probe. General callback ownership remains pending. Production Worker native controls are run separately in this feature.
